items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And we liked each other immediately . he was very nice to me, treated me very nice, and I liked him because he treated me nice.

ctx.x: He would close up, then he'd run sessions after-hours with the guys that he wanted to be there.. So I went out there after we got off from work and met Eddie. And we liked each other immediately . he was very nice to me, treated me very nice, and I liked him because he treated me nice.

So I was laying up in bed one night and the phone rings; it's Eddie, it's 12 o'clock at night. I said, "Who in the hell is calling me at this time of night." It was Eddie. "Hey, Maggie," he says, "hop on the plane and come on up." I said, "Wait a minute. What do you mean? Come on up where? And what for?" So he said, "Look, you just come on up here; I'll take care of you." I said, "Well, okay, all right." So I got dressed and went and got on a plane and went on to Boston. When I got there he had a limousine…
